ui.chat.composer_media.confirms.note: Follows the separately rendered Enter keycap; lowercase verb.

ui.chat.composer_media.cancels.note: Follows the separately rendered Esc keycap; lowercase verb.

ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_type.note: Fallback filename for pasted data URI. mimeType is an unchanged technical MIME identifier.

ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_file.note: Fallback filename when pasted data URI has no name or MIME type.

ui.chat.composer_media.preview_failed.note: Media decode failure tooltip; file-bridge failure reasons remain owned by the shared hook.

ui.chat.composer_media.remove_attachment.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the attachment remove button.
